writeup.key_factor: Home team in form (4-2-0 at home) with Stutzle on a points streak, against a Rangers side missing Shesterkin and Korpisalo and losers of 4 straight on the road. Model edge clears the NHL 4% gate even after a 3-4 point discount for Ullmark being out.
writeup.risk: Backup goalie Samuel Ersson (0-3-0, .835 SV%) starts with Ullmark on IR; Ottawa just lost 6-2 to San Jose. Minimum acceptable price -148.

writeup.key_factor: Showcase pick: home team on a 3-game win streak against the last-place Ducks on a 5-game skid, with expected starter Joseph Woll (.917 SV%) against Dostal (.881). Strong home side against a weaker road opponent, inside the 1.80-2.20 showcase band.
writeup.risk: 1:00 PM ET puck drop leaves no margin if approval slips past the 11 AM publication; Tippett and Konecny are out. Held at Gold rather than Platinum for the tight window and the missing scorers. Minimum acceptable price -125 (band floor).

writeup.key_factor: Showcase pick: strong 7-3-0 team that won both games against Utah last season, at +120 (decimal 2.20, exactly at the top of the 1.80-2.20 showcase band). Model favorite despite the market dog price.
writeup.risk: Second night of a back-to-back after playing in Colorado on Friday; starting goalie unconfirmed at midday (Vasilevskiy played Friday, backup Hildeby is 0-1-0 with .854 SV% lifetime vs Utah). Pregame check at 8:00 PM ET must re-verify the starter. Minimum acceptable price +103.
